newsitem.title: UK: UK's CAA pension fund drops Jardine Fleming-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's CAA pension fund drops Jardine Fleming-paper.

text.p: The UK's Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) pension fund has withdrawn two portfolios from the management of Jardine Fleming, the Financial News reported in its Monday edition.

"We have withdrawn two portfolios from Jardine Fleming, each worth around 21.5 million sterling. We reviewed the position in consequence of recent matters disclosed in the press and took the decision only after extensive discussions with Jardine Fleming," the weekly paper quoted the CAA as saying.

The CAA move follows problems at Jardine Fleming Investment Management. Last month, regulators fined Jardine Fleming 700,000 sterling and withdrew the authorisation of its London-based fund company following revelations of the late allocation of trades by a senior fund manager in Hong Kong.
